turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My daughter wants to help cook on Saturday and I need something a seven year old can do.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold your thoughts until I've described all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Homemade pizza, where she rolls the dough and picks her own toppings, though the kitchen will get covered in flour.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe meatballs, she'd love squishing them, but raw meat and little hands make me a bit nervous.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or fruit skewers with a yogurt dip, which is safe and quick but maybe not very exciting for her.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Possibly pancakes, she can stir and pour while I do the flipping at the stove.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Pizza is the winner for a seven year old, she gets to make choices and it feels like her dinner. The pancakes are a close second. Meatballs are fine with hand washing, and the skewers might be over in five minutes.
